title: [Bugfix][Frontend] Count prompts over max_model_len in Anthropic count_tokens

commits.note: Initial submission: optional tok_params on render_chat_request / OnlineRenderer.render_chat / OnlineRenderer.preprocess_chat
Review round 1: count-only ChatCompletionRequest subclass with TokenizeChatRequest-style build_tok_params; shared signatures restored

root_cause: count_tokens renders through render_chat_request with ChatCompletionRequest.build_tok_params (max_total_tokens=max_model_len): tokenization stops at max_model_len + 1 tokens and _token_len_check raises a 400, while /tokenize renders with max_total_tokens=None
fix: The count branch of _build_base_request builds _CountTokensChatRequest, a ChatCompletionRequest whose build_tok_params matches TokenizeChatRequest.build_tok_params (max_total_tokens=None, max_output_tokens=0, add_special_tokens from the request). count_tokens still renders through render_chat_request, so templating, tools, thinking and the tool/reasoning parsers (isinstance ChatCompletionRequest check) are unchanged; no shared signatures change. Generation keeps the check; Harmony chat rendering never applied tok params

review_round_1.text: Perhaps it would be better to define a separate function to do this just like for `/tokenize`? cc @chaunceyjiang
review_round_1.interpretation: Own the uncapped tokenization params in a request type's build_tok_params, as TokenizeChatRequest (and decisions' ReadPromptRequest) do, instead of passing tok_params through shared render functions
review_round_1.reply_offer: Switch to a fully separate render path like create_tokenize if preferred
